product.audience: Training-focused runners comparing one daily shoe across gait phase, surface and preferred ride
product.decision: Understand how the Vector 01 chassis behaves under load and select the appropriate edition
product.conversion: Resolve a transparent gait calibration and reserve the selected edition

signature.moment: A manipulable WebGL shoe splits into upper, carrier and outsole while a stride dial moves the assembly from touchdown through toe-off and redraws the active force path

systems.hero: A full-viewport instrument bay with a real-time 3D shoe suspended between a specimen rail and a stride-phase console; the product is the interface, not a decorative image
systems.navigation: A compact lab coordinate strip with direct mode controls; no overlay menu, cinematic chapter index or commerce header
systems.contentDensity: Dense at the live rig, sparse across pressure evidence, comparative at editions and concise at reservation
systems.geometry: Black instrument void inside warm ruled paper, orbital measurement arcs, vertical readout rails and horizontal race-lane data strips
systems.motion: Spring-based layer separation, pointer-driven rotation and phase-to-phase chassis articulation; scroll reveals are secondary and reduced motion freezes a fully legible posed frame
systems.coreInteraction: Visitors rotate and explode the shoe, inspect individual construction layers, scrub three gait phases and feed terrain, strike and ride choices into a deterministic edition recommendation

structuralDifferences: The desktop side rails become one bottom instrument tray placed directly under a shorter square 3D viewport
Stride phases are explicit previous and next thumb controls rather than a wide simultaneous timeline
Layer inspection becomes a stacked wallet that promotes one construction layer at a time while keeping explode and reset controls visible
Calibration questions remain a focused one-question sequence and appear before long-form pressure evidence

artDirection.typography: A wide grotesk voice for runner-facing statements paired with compact monospace instrumentation; sentence case replaces fashion-editorial display conventions
artDirection.material: Warm test paper surrounding a near-black optical bay, cobalt structural surfaces, signal-orange forces and translucent engineered mesh
artDirection.imageLogic: The existing original product still remains a below-fold material proof; the signature product is built from code-native WebGL geometry, SVG force maps and semantic data
artDirection.microcopy: Touchdown, midstance, toe-off, carrier deflection, heel load, rocker release, stack and contact rubber language
artDirection.dataHonesty: All force, phase and recommendation values are explicitly illustrative product demonstrations, never medical assessment or live biomechanical measurement

interactions.name: Force chassis explorer
interactions.input: Pointer drag or explicit rotate, explode, reset, layer and stride-phase controls
interactions.stateChange: 3D layer position, opacity, emphasis, chassis pitch, force ring and phase readouts change
interactions.visibleResult: The runner sees which construction layer carries the selected stride phase and reads its illustrative load path

interactions.name: Gait calibration
interactions.input: Terrain, foot strike and preferred ride
interactions.stateChange: Edition, pressure trace, ride profile and recommendation rationale update
interactions.visibleResult: A named Vector edition and transparent three-input rationale appear in the fit receipt

interactions.name: Fit reservation
interactions.input: Runner name, email and preferred size
interactions.stateChange: Inline validation resolves into a local demo hold
interactions.visibleResult: A fit-file reference and 24-hour hold confirmation replace the form

assetStrategy: One existing original AI-generated product photograph remains the material evidence anchor and is not repeated. The signature 3D product, force rings and stride visualization are generated in code so they remain interactive, palette-aware and resolution-independent.

assets.role: Below-fold photographic proof of knit, foam and outsole material under laboratory light
assets.focalCrop: Complete lateral shoe and test platen remain visible
assets.mobileSafeArea: Central shoe silhouette retained in a shallow crop with equipment allowed to fall away

adjacentTemplates.why: The existing 3D asset marketplace uses an atmospheric object viewport and collection browsing; this rig is a technical shoe assembly whose geometry changes to explain gait phase and construction
No pinned image-film chapters or trim atelier: the footwear hero is a direct-manipulation WebGL instrument with force-phase controls
The product does not orbit as luxury spectacle or end in allocation; it separates into functional layers and feeds an explainable fit calibration
Room planning and dimension placement are replaced by stride articulation, force paths and a thumb-operated phase dial
The film template edits a shot sequence and treatment; this product interface manipulates physical layers and gait-state telemetry

avoid: generic rotating object with no useful state
desktop side panels simply stacked on mobile
oversized uppercase plus italic serif typography
generic card grid and side-drawer conversion
auto-rotation without a stop or reduced-motion state
medical gait claims or fabricated athlete endorsements
